record.NAME: k_recw_min_rel_velocity
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimal relative velocity of an object has to be greater or equal than this calibration value to be considered for alert level 1 and alert level 2.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_rel_velocity_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the minimal relative velocity k_recw_min_rel_velocity for alert level 1 and alert level 2. This value is subtracted from the corresponding array value of k_recw_min_rel_velocity, if the object was critical before.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_heading
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal heading angle of an object to be considered for RECW depending on alert level.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_heading_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the heading angle of an object to be considered for RECW. The value will be added to k_recw_max_approach_angle if the object was critical before.

record.NAME: k_recw_factor_ego_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Factor to adapt the relevant ego width in order to adjust the feature sensitivity.

record.NAME: k_recw_average_sensor_latency
record.DESCRIPTION: Average overall latency between real world and feature output in seconds.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_crash_prob
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal crash probability to raise a level 1 alert and level 2 alert.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_existence_prob
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal existence probability to raise a level 1 alert and level 2 alert.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_existence_prob_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for minimal existence probability to raise a level 1 alert. This value will be subtracted from k_recw_min_existence_prob[0], if the object was critical before.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_make_use_of_guardrail
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to activate consideration of guardrail information in estimation of crash probability.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_only_allow_consecutive_alert_levels
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to only allow consecutive alerts. If activated level 2 alerts can only follow a previous level 1 alert.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_allow_alert_on_coasted_objects
record.DESCRIPTION: Flags define if coasted objects are allowed to raise an alert of level 1 and alert of level 2.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_use_rear_blockage
record.DESCRIPTION: Flags define whether the rear end blockage algorithm should be used for alert level 1 and alert of level 2.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_apply_lane_filter
record.DESCRIPTION: If flag is true, targets outside the ego lane will be exluded from warnings.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_enable_heading_filter
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to enable usage of the heading filter. If turned off the filtered heading will be replaced with the heading provided by the tracker.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_enable_traffic_light_ghost_detection
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to enable the traffic light ghost detection.

record.NAME: k_recb_f_enable_recb
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to enable the RECB functionality. If turned off RECB will be disabled.

record.NAME: k_recw_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for alerts of level 1 and alerts of level 2.

record.NAME: k_recw_alert_qualifying_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of qualifying cycles for alert level 1. Alert level 2 does not require qualifying.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_stage_age_for_alert_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal stage age to raise an alert of level 1 and alert of level 2. Coasted objects are also controlled via k_recw_max_allowed_consecutive_coasted_cycles and k_recw_f_allow_alert_on_coasted_objects.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_ttc_for_alert_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal TTC at which a level 1 alert and a level 2 alert can be raised.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_overlap_for_alert_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum overlap of predicted object position at the host rear bumper to output alert level 1 an 2.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_cycles_alert_duration
record.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum number of cycles a warning can be active for alert level 1 and alert level 2 before it will be disabled. This is independent on the target that caused the warning.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal host speed, alert level dependant, for which RECW should be operational.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_host_speed_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the minimal host speed for which RECW should be operational. The value will be subtracted from k_recw_min_host_speed if RECW was operational before.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal host speed, alert level dependant, for which RECW should be operational.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_host_speed_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the maximal host speed for which RECW should be operational. The value will be added to k_recw_max_host_speed if RECW was operational before.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_rel_velocity_for_max_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal relative velocity for alert level 1 and alert level 2 for which the corresponding maximal ttc threshold from k_recw_max_ttc_threshold shall be used. For lower relative velocities the ttc threshold decreases linearly.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal ttc threshold that should be used for alert level 1 and alert level 2. This will be applied for valid relative velocities greater or equal to the corresponding array entry of k_recw_min_rel_velocity_for_max_ttc_threshold.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_age_for_close_slow_targets
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum age that a slow and close target must have to raise an alert

record.NAME: k_recw_min_dist_for_young_slow_targets
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum distance of a young and slow target to raise an alert

record.NAME: k_recw_min_abs_speed_for_young_close_targets
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum absolute speed of a young and close target to raise an alert

record.NAME: k_recw_min_object_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal age of an object in cycles to be considered by RECW.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_rel_velocity
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximal relative velocity of an object has to be equal or less than this calibration value (alert level dependant) to be considered by RECW.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_rel_velocity_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the maximal relative velocity k_recw_max_rel_velocity. This value is added to k_recw_max_rel_velocity, if the object was critical before.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_cycles_with_min_crash_prob
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of consecutive cycles a crash probability of k_recw_min_crash_prob[0] for alert level 1 has to be reached before an object can raise an alert.

record.NAME: k_recw_en_active_car_wash_logic
record.DESCRIPTION: 0 - car wash deactivated, 1 - car wash logic based on target state, 2 - car wash logic based on neutral gear position.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_rel_lon_vel_release_car_wash
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum relative longitudinal velocity between ego and target at which the PCR warning suppresion due to car wash logic can be released.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_lon_distance_car_wash
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum initial longitudinal distance between ego and target vehicle in which the PCR warning can be suppressed due to car wash logic.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_lat_distance_car_wash
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum initial lateral distance between ego and target vehicle in which the PCR warning can be suppressed due to car wash logic.

record.NAME: k_recw_min_rel_lon_vel_car_wash
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum initial relative longitudinal velocity between ego and target at which the PCR warning can be suppressed due to car wash logic.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_speed_ego_car_wash
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum ego speed at which car wash logic will be applied.

record.NAME: k_recw_lane_filter_width
record.DESCRIPTION: If k_recw_f_apply_lane_filter is active, only objects inside a zone with the respective lane width will be considered as relevant for RECW.

record.NAME: k_recw_lane_filter_width_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the lane filter width. This value will be added to k_recw_lane_filter_width, if the object was critical before.

record.NAME: k_recw_lane_filter_max_abs_ego_speed_vcs_coord
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum absolute ego speed for which the lane filter calculation will be done with vcs coordinates instead of curvi coordinates.

record.NAME: k_recw_lane_width_slope
record.DESCRIPTION: Slope that can be used to increase the lane width used for the lane filter at higher distances.

record.NAME: k_recw_lane_filter_num_consecutive_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of consecutive cycles required by target to be within lane in order to be able to trigger warning

record.NAME: k_recw_lookup_braking_deceleration
record.DESCRIPTION: Look-up table of brake deceleration used for look up of braking probability.

record.NAME: k_recw_lookup_braking_probability
record.DESCRIPTION: Look-up table of probabilities assigned to braking decelerations specified in k_recw_lookup_braking_deceleration.

record.NAME: k_recw_lookup_steering_acceleration
record.DESCRIPTION: Look-up table of steering acceleration used for look up of steering probability.

record.NAME: k_recw_lookup_steering_probability
record.DESCRIPTION: Look-up table of probabilities assigned to steering accelerations specified in k_recw_lookup_steering_acceleration.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_eclipse_value_for_valid_object
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal allowed eclipse value for an object to be considered as valid for RECW.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_object_width_warn_on
record.DESCRIPTION: This is the max object width to be considered by the algo

record.NAME: k_recw_max_allowed_consecutive_coasted_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal number of consecutive coasted cycles for which an object is still considered as valid for RECW.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_allowed_rel_vel_long_diff
record.DESCRIPTION: This defines the maximal allowed difference between the internally filtered longitudinal relative velocity and the one provided by the tracker for a valid object.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_allowed_rel_vel_lat_diff
record.DESCRIPTION: This defines the maximal allowed difference between the internally filtered lateral relative velocity and the one provided by the tracker for a valid object.

record.NAME: k_recw_max_allowed_heading_diff
record.DESCRIPTION: This defines the maximal allowed difference between the internally filtered heading and the one provided by the tracker for a valid object.

record.NAME: k_recw_rear_blockage_qualifying_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of consecutive qualifying cycles with rear blockage before rear blockage is set for alert level calculation.

record.NAME: k_recw_rear_blockage_speed_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects below this speed threshold are considered valid as blockers for the ego rear.

record.NAME: k_recw_rear_blockage_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Width of blockage zone.

record.NAME: k_recw_rear_blockage_length
record.DESCRIPTION: Length of blockage zone.

record.NAME: k_recw_rear_blockage_ego_speed_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Ego speed threshold to release rear blockage. If object speed is above this value rear blockage cannot be active.

record.NAME: k_recw_heading_accuracy_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal allowed heading accuracy (greater values are less accurate)

record.NAME: k_recw_min_speed_not_stationary
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum speed an object needs to provide so that it is classified as non-stationary.

record.NAME: k_recb_max_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal host speed for which RECB can raise a braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_max_host_speed_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for maximal host speed for which RECB can raise a braking request. This value will be added to k_recb_max_host_speed if the host speed was in the allowed range before.

record.NAME: k_recb_min_cycles_host_standstill
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal time for which the host has to be stationary before a braking request can be raised.

record.NAME: k_recb_max_velocity_host_standstill
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal velocity for which the host vehicle will be considered as standstill in the calculation of k_recb_min_cycles_host_standstill.

record.NAME: k_recb_min_rel_velocity
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal relative velocity of the relevant target which is required to raise a braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_min_rel_velocity_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the minimal relative velocity of an object to be able to raise a braking request. This value will be subtracted from k_recb_min_rel_velocity if a braking request was active before.

record.NAME: k_recb_max_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: The TTC of the relevant target is required to be below this threshold to raise a braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_nominal_acceleration_applied
record.DESCRIPTION: The acceleration which is applied to the brakes if a braking request is raised.

record.NAME: k_recb_ssm_braking
record.DESCRIPTION: The standstill management required during a braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_ssm_request_cancelled
record.DESCRIPTION: The standstill management required if a braking request is cancelled.

record.NAME: k_recb_integrity
record.DESCRIPTION: The ASIL level required for the braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_qualifier_nominal_acceleration
record.DESCRIPTION: The mode requested by Central Vehicle Management required for the braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_max_cycles_braking_request_duration
record.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum number of cycles a braking request can be active before it will be cancelled. This is independent on the target that caused the braking request.

record.NAME: k_recb_accelerator_pedal_gradient_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for the accelerator pedal gradient above which a braking request will be cancelled immediately.

record.NAME: k_recw_f_suppress_alert_lvl_2_for_pedestrian
record.DESCRIPTION: Suppress alert level 2 for pedestrian object.
